input.prompt: A single continuous 8-second luxury jewellery editorial macro film, photorealistic, for a sophisticated Malaysian gold jewellery boutique website. Keep the central upper area dark and uncluttered for a website headline to be added separately. Begin and end with nearly identical framing and illumination so it can loop gracefully.
